cohort: The study included 298 RIF patients and 2056 controls (women who achieved successful embryo implantation within 1-2 transfer cycles) identified from 15,329 ART cycles at the Reproductive Medical Center at the First Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University.
finding: Anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) was identified as the strongest predictor for RIF, with elevated AMH levels and a greater number of live births associated with lower risk, while chronic endometritis, intrauterine adhesions, BMI, advanced age, high FSH/testosterone, polyps, recurrent pregnancy loss, history of cesarean section, PCOS, and rheumatic diseases were associated with higher risk.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was associated with a higher risk of recurrent implantation failure.
